scorecard.rationale: The whole dried Ajwa date crossover (NCT02288611, n=21) never published its mood diary, the Ajwa schizophrenia adjunct trial reported composite ratings only, and an acute date-drink alertness crossover (n=15) lacked verified fruit maturity and an apathy scale. The 45-pair Parkinson baseline analysis measured apathy/indifference, with an unadjusted caregiver-burden association that was not retained after adjustment and no date intervention. Dried date effects on Parkinson apathy remain open.
